notes:
## What this does

Every morning it reads the career boards of the companies you list and tells you only the
adverts that are new since yesterday. Nothing else is repeated, so the message is short
enough to actually read.

Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and SmartRecruiters are covered. Give a board URL, a
"platform:slug" like lever:leverdemo, or just the company slug and all four are tried.

New job adverts are the earliest public sign of what a company is building, which team is
growing, and which office is being staffed. Sales teams watch them for a reason to call.

## Setup

1. Install the Apify node. It is verified by n8n, so it works on Cloud and on self-hosted.
2. Add your Apify API key in the node credentials. A free Apify account is enough to start.
3. Put your companies in the "Companies to watch" node.
4. Point the Slack node at a channel, or delete it and connect whatever you use instead.

The Actor is gubidonius/company-jobs-scraper. These are the boards' own public JSON
endpoints, so there is no login and no proxy to configure.
